## Research notes (`research/`)

## Where to look (routing)
Reach any experiment in three reads: [experiments/INDEX.md](experiments/INDEX.md) -> `experiments/<topic>/README.md` -> the file.

| Task | Look in |
|---|---|
| What did we conclude, is it still open | [research/decisions.md](research/decisions.md) (one line per entry) -> `research/decisions/<N>.md` |
| One experiment: code, results, figures, status | `experiments/INDEX.md` -> `experiments/<topic>/README.md` |
| Shared Python code (data paths, openpilot / Alpamayo runners, run dirs) | `jevdrive/` |
| Shared box entry points (tmux, downloads, CARLA server, B2D harness) | `scripts/`, [docs/README.md](docs/README.md) |
| A CARLA / Bench2Drive run | [docs/closed-loop-runbook.md](docs/closed-loop-runbook.md), `jevdrive/cl/` |
| Narrative, literature, roadmap (Chinese) | [research/README.md](research/README.md) |
| An old path from a note or a commit | [docs/path-map.tsv](docs/path-map.tsv), then `git show {{base_sha}}:<old path>` |
| GPU box / Tokyo box / a failed download | [docs/remote-box.md](docs/remote-box.md), [docs/tokyo-box.md](docs/tokyo-box.md), [docs/network-proxy.md](docs/network-proxy.md) (`source /etc/network_turbo`, then `proxy_on`) |

Layout: `experiments/<topic>/{README.md, scripts/, lib/, results/, figs/, archive/, plans/}`. `archive/` holds the
one-off code of a concluded experiment: reproduce from it, do not extend it. Code that a second experiment imports
goes to `lib/`; code that three experiments import goes to `jevdrive/` (or `scripts/` for box entry points).
A new experiment is a new topic dir with a README (template in [docs/restructure-design.md](docs/restructure-design.md))
and one line in `experiments/INDEX.md`; refresh the file lists with `python tools/restructure_docs.py`.
